stem:
The table shows the numbers of puzzle pieces in four puzzles. Derek put together the two puzzles that had the greatest numbers of pieces.

Puzzle Pieces

Puzzle      Number of Pieces
Lion        402
Boat        498
Garden      419
Waterfall   473

What is the total number of pieces in these two puzzles?
visual_elements: Table with puzzles: Lion 402, Boat 498, Garden 419, Waterfall 473
difficulty_rationale: Requires identifying the two greatest numbers and adding them, straightforward one-step calculation.
